title: Show HN: Freenet, a peer-to-peer platform for decentralized apps
summary: Freenet is a ground-up redesign of the classic peer-to-peer network (originally Hyphanet from the 2000s), now running with early applications like River (decentralized group chat), Delta (decentralized CMS), and Atlas (in-development search engine). Users are already building custom apps including games on this censorship-resistant platform.
problem_solved: Enables privacy-focused, censorship-resistant decentralized applications without centralized servers.
why_valuable: Provides true network decentralization with built-in anonymity, anti-censorship, and offline-first capabilities backed by 5 years of development.
